quantiles: Nearest rank; browser and HTTP-burst groups have n10, so p95=max; HTTP per-request groups have 10/20/40 observations by reader count. Source is first navigation in a fresh browser context, including rows whose later destination is warm. No success-only filtering.
sourceAccounting: Source observation includes existing bounded drain; late pending request bytes are unavailable, so source body bytes are observed totals, not proof of full eventual accounting. Complete font transfers are counted independently.
